---
params:
  input_name:
    label: "Input data name"
    value: "UNKNOWN"
  df_rdv:
    label: "Input RDV"
    value: "?"
  df_pde:
    label: "Demographics RDV"
    value: "?"
  event_col:
    label: "Event column"
    value: "?"
  cohort_col:
    label: "Stratify column"
    value: "cohort"
  order_by:
    label: "Order by stratify value"
    value: NULL
  nplot:
    label: "Number to plot"
    value: 10
  new_col:
    label: "Create new column to analyse?"
    value: FALSE
  new_col_breaks:
    label: "A numeric vector or a single number for cut()"
    value: NULL
  new_col_labels:
    label: "Labels for the categories to use in cut()"
    value: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

if (params$input_name != "UNKNOWN") {
  description <- params$input_name
} else if (!is.null(names(params$event_col)[[1]])) {
  description <- names(params$event_col)[[1]]
} else {
  description <- params$event_col[[1]]
}

```


```{r run-analysis}
gfa_result <- driveanalytics::gen_frequency_analysis(params$df_rdv, params$df_pde, params$event_col, params$cohort_col, params$new_col, params$new_col_breaks, params$new_col_labels)
gfa_result_n <- head(gfa_result, params$nplot, params$order_by)
gfa_result_all <- head(gfa_result, 17, params$order_by)
```
